section: Judge.me star rating above product title — clickable wrapper
commit_message: feat(pdp): make rating block a single clickable wrapper
acceptance_criteria: The entire rating row (stars and review count) is one clickable element, not a nested anchor-in-anchor
Clicking anywhere in the rating row smooth-scrolls the Judge.me review widget section into view accounting for the sticky header
No change to visual presentation from the previously released rating block
